gui.rs_create_compat.advanced_quantity_k.en: Autocraft column: click a row's check/cross to toggle autocrafting for that row (requires an Autocrafting Upgrade; without it these buttons stay disabled).
gui.rs_create_compat.advanced_quantity_k.zh: 自动合成列：点某行的 ✓/✗ 切换该行是否自动合成（必须先装入自动合成升级，否则这一列按钮保持禁用、点都点不了）。

gui.rs_create_compat.advanced_quantity_k.en: Destroy-overflow column: click a row's check/cross to let that row destroy the amount beyond its target amount.
gui.rs_create_compat.advanced_quantity_k.zh: 过量销毁列：点某行的 ✓/✗ 切换该行「超出目标数量的部分是否销毁」。

gui.rs_create_compat.exporter_executor.l.zh: 本总线已连到一台处于「总线输出」模式的序列执行仓（贴着放或用 RS 线缆直达，最多 64 格）。类别由执行仓按单元样板动态给出，可多选；原来的过滤器槽位不可编辑。
gui.rs_create_compat.exporter_executor.l.en: This bus is linked to a sequence execution chamber in Bus Output mode (adjacent, or reached through RS cables up to 64 blocks). Categories come from the chamber's unit patterns and can be multi-selected; the original filter slots are locked.

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.en: Bus output: per-face settings are ignored; an exporter bus placed next to the chamber or reached through a run of RS cables does the work.
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.zh: 总线输出：忽略逐面配置，由紧贴或线缆相连的「输出总线」代劳。

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.en: Note: bus output is active, so this face config is ignored (it takes effect again in face output mode).
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.zh: 注意：当前为「总线输出」模式，该面的配置被整体忽略（切回「面输出」后立即恢复生效）。
